name: Thonet
tagline: Bentwood furniture since the nineteenth century.
short: The German house that pioneered bentwood furniture, with light, structural forms shaped from steam-bent beech, and a lasting benchmark of modern design.
long:
Thonet is the German house that pioneered bentwood furniture in the nineteenth century, shaping beech by steam into light, enduring forms.

Its chairs remain benchmarks of modern design: quiet, structural and made to last. The 118 continues that lineage in a pared-back, contemporary silhouette.
